newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Maui oil f'cast raised 11 pct-FCL Energy.
newsitem.headline: Maui oil f'cast raised 11 pct-FCL Energy.

text.p: Fletcher Challenge Energy Ltd said on Monday that Shell Todd Oil Services, the New Zealand North Island Maui field operator, has upgraded its forecast of Maui oil production.

"With the better reservoir performance in the D Sands, the operator expects the ultimate recovery of oil from existing wells to be 24.7 million barrels -- 11 percent higher than previous estimates," FCL Energy said in a statement.
FCL Energy controls 68.75 percent of the offshore field.
